subject: Sales discovery — model fit & evals follow-up / quality regression concern
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@retailco.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Sales discovery recap — recommended models, prompt sets, next steps

Hi Alice —

Great to meet you and Tom earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call:

1) Summary of need
- RetailCo wants higher consistency on product-attribute extraction and fewer hallucinated product names for the recommendations flow.
- Current SLOs you mentioned: <200ms p95, precision >= 92% on the canonical eval set.

2) Initial model recommendations (based on the samples you shared)
- redwood-llama-70b-int8-v2 (balanced accuracy / latency)
- open-instruct-13b-q4 (lower cost, good for simple completions)

3) Evals & artifacts I shared
- Attached: retailco_promptset_v2.txt (the prompt set we discussed) and benchmark_results_aug24.pdf (initial local runs).
- Link to the benchmark folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleBenchmarkDocs

4) Risks you highlighted
- You reported a quality regression after a model/version update on Aug 24 — we should prioritize reproducing those failures.

5) Proposed next steps
- Permission for Redwood SRE/SE to run a smoke evaluation on a pinned previous model version (redwood-llama-70b-int8-v1) against your evaluation dataset.
- If regressions are confirmed, proposed mitigation: canary pin to v1 for RetailCo traffic -> run a full regression suite -> either keep pinned or roll forward with fixes.
- Schedule: we can run the smoke eval within 24 hours of receiving dataset access.

Could you confirm: (a) a preferred contact for engineering access (S3/GCS link or Drive), and (b) whether you want us to proceed with a 10% canary pin if we confirm a regression?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

---
Attachments (stubs): retailco_promptset_v2.txt, benchmark_results_aug24.pdf
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@retailco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@retailco.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sales discovery recap — recommended models, prompt sets, next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the summary and the prompt set. Quick update from our side: after the prod model update on Aug 24 we saw a noticeable uptick in bad/blank product-name fills in the recommendations flow. I attached a short file with examples (failure_examples_aug24.txt) — you can see where the model either invents product names or leaves the field blank while the previous version returned correct canonical names.

We definitely want you to run the smoke eval. We'll provide S3 access to a scrubbed eval dataset; I looped in Tom who will share the link.

Yes to a 10% canary if you confirm a regression. This is impacting a small set of customers and we want a fast mitigation path.

Appreciate quick help here —
Alice
Senior Product Manager, Recommendations
RetailCo
alice.chen@retailco.com

---
Attachments (stubs): failure_examples_aug24.txt
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@retailco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sales discovery recap — recommended models, prompt sets, next steps

Thanks Alice + Marissa —

I've started an initial triage with the SE team. Early notes:
- We ran small reproductions locally against the examples you shared; several failures do line up with a decoder sampling/hyperparam change that landed in the v2 rollout.
- I've attached a quick diff (model_diffs_aug25.csv) showing the top config/kernel changes between redwood-llama-70b-int8-v1 and v2 for inference (sampling_temp, top_p, tokenizer-truncation).

Immediate recommendation:
1) Pin RetailCo traffic to redwood-llama-70b-int8-v1 as a canary at 10% while we run the full regression suite on your eval dataset. If that looks good we can extend the pin to 100% and then investigate forward fixes.
2) If you approve, our SEs will need read access to the eval artifacts (S3/GCS link) and a small production request sample (headers redacting PII) for log correlation.

We aim to have a smoke-run result back within 12-24 hours after we receive the dataset.

Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

---
Attachments (stubs): model_diffs_aug25.csv
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@retailco.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sales discovery recap — recommended models, prompt sets, next steps

Hi all —

Confirming engineering plan and timelines:
- We'll schedule a 10% canary pin of RetailCo traffic to redwood-llama-70b-int8-v1 tomorrow at 10:00 PDT pending dataset access and Alice's confirmation.
- During the canary we'll run the full regression suite (canonical eval + 3 targeted prompt buckets from retailco_promptset_v2.txt). If regression delta > 3% absolute precision drop on any bucket, we'll halt the rollout and keep v1 pinned until we ship a corrected v2.

Action items for RetailCo (Alice / Tom):
- Share S3/GCS link to scrubbed eval dataset and a short sample of production requests for correlation.
- Confirm approval for 10% canary pin.

We will send a post-canary summary (latency, token cost delta, accuracy by bucket) as soon as the suite completes.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@retailco.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sales discovery recap — recommended models, prompt sets, next steps

Thanks Rishi —

We approved the 10% canary pin. Sharing the eval artifacts here (S3 link): s3://retailco-evals/scrubbed/recommendations/2026-08-20/

Tom (cc) will also drop a short sample of production requests into the folder this afternoon. Please let us know when the canary is scheduled and when the post-canary report is ready.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Alice
